shots.line: So why were the Marshals at that airfield at all?
shots.what: real: helicopter view of the hangar; chapter lettering types on

shots.line: They weren't following a tip.
shots.what: real: Malkowski at the map on the vehicle

shots.line: State police had asked them to clear the abandoned resort, the old Birchwood Pocono Airpark
shots.what: road map: the airpark pinned as it is named, the barracks to the north

shots.line: near Tannersville, and they were working through it.
shots.what: 3D callback: the line of marshals crossing the field

shots.line: Malkowski said afterward,
shots.what: real: Malkowski; name tag types on

shots.line: "We just had a hunch that if we were on the run, this is a place we would hide."
shots.what: typed quote card, line by line

lines: THAT IF WE WERE ON THE RUN,

shots.line: You know what happened next.
shots.what: 3D callback: he steps out of the trees

shots.line: The black hat,
shots.what: 3D callback: the black hat

shots.line: the order to get down,
shots.what: 3D callback: he goes to his knees

shots.line: his name.
shots.what: callback: the FBI photo and his name

shots.line: There's one thing the accounts don't agree on.
shots.what: typed card

card.who: OF HOW HIS FACE WAS SCRAPED

shots.line: An early public account said nobody was hurt during the capture,
shots.what: real: the State Police commissioner at the microphones

shots.line: but Frein's face was scraped,
shots.what: real photo, 1.8 seconds, wide, no zoom: the perp walk

shots.line: and the Marshals themselves said that happened while he was held face down on the pavement.
shots.what: 3D: the crane up over him on the ground, marshals around

shots.line: Both versions are on the record, so you're getting both.
shots.what: typed card

shots.line: He wasn't armed in that field.
shots.what: 3D callback: his open, empty hand

shots.line: There were weapons inside the hangar, and so was the notebook.
shots.what: real photo: inside the hangar

shots.line: This was the longer journal, not the three pages from the trash bag,
shots.what: typed card (the 3D notebook read badly: creator's note Nov 25, 2026)

card.who: NOT THE THREE PAGES FROM THE TRASH BAG

shots.line: and it doesn't read like a soldier on a mission.
shots.what: police-released photo: Frein in re-enactor uniform

shots.line: On September twenty-fifth, he wrote that he slept like a human first time in two weeks.
shots.what: typed journal quote, amber bar

card.who: ERIC FREIN'S JOURNAL, SEPT 25  ·  COURT RECORD

shots.line: On October eleventh, he wrote, "Thirty days. A lot longer than I expected to last."
shots.what: typed journal quote, amber bar

card.who: ERIC FREIN'S JOURNAL, OCT 11  ·  COURT RECORD

shots.line: Police also recovered a file on a storage drive. It was a letter addressed Mom and Dad,
shots.what: 3D object: a screen; the file types on as it is described
shots.head: STORAGE DRIVE  ·  COURT RECORD

shots.line: and in it, he wrote that, "The time seems right for a spark to ignite a fire in the hearts of men."
shots.what: typed quote card

lines: FOR A SPARK TO IGNITE A FIRE

shots.line: and last accessed on October sixth, twenty-fourteen.
shots.what: typed card

shots.line: Those dates don't tell us when any particular line was written, only when the file was made and when it was last opened.
shots.what: 3D object: the screen again; the two things the dates do tell us type on

shots.what: typed card

shots.line: He called the killing an assassination,

shots.what: typed card; the words appear when they are said
